recommendation.reason: It combines exact Ethiopian marketplace visibility, an active Gezat listing with year and vehicle details, an additional exact Adey listing, and a model-specific parts catalogue with prices and VIN-based compatibility guidance. This provides the most complete and deadline-feasible evidence chain for the later spare-parts investigation.
recommendation.important_tradeoff: Changan BenBen E-Star has the largest Adey listing count and an active Golden listing, but its technical and parts-compatibility evidence is weaker. Toyota bZ4X has strong exact listings and a dedicated parts catalogue, but Adey records inspected individually were unavailable and the grouped bZ-series count cannot be used as a bZ4X count.
recommendation.status: provisional vehicle-selection recommendation; no spare-part scoring performed
